name: ECR-2026-100010
chnage_description: Modify the door latch reinforcement bracket geometry to improve structural strength and durability. Increase the bracket thickness from 2.0 mm to 2.5 mm and add a localized reinforcement rib while maintaining the existing mounting interfaces.
reason_for_change: The current bracket has shown insufficient structural margin during durability testing. The proposed reinforcement is required to improve durability performance and reduce the risk of warranty-related failures.
business_justification: The proposed change is expected to improve product durability and reduce potential warranty and field failure costs. It will also improve structural robustness without changing the primary mounting interface.
current_state: Existing door latch reinforcement bracket uses a 2.0 mm thickness with the current baseline geometry and mounting configuration.
proposed_state: Door latch reinforcement bracket will use 2.5 mm thickness with an additional localized reinforcement rib. Existing mounting interfaces and functional dimensions will be maintained.
engineering_notes:
Cost Impact: Estimated unit cost increase of $0.50 due to the revised component specification. Initial implementation cost is expected to be minimal.

Technical Requirements: Supplier shall validate the revised part specification, confirm manufacturing capability, and provide a quotation for the revised component. Supplier must confirm dimensional compliance and expected lead time for the revised part.

Commercial Requirements: Existing supplier shall quote the revised component based on the updated specification. Quote should include unit price, tooling or setup charges if applicable, and any one-time implementation cost.

Delivery Requirements: Supplier shall confirm revised-part lead time and provide samples within 2 weeks. Production ramp-up should not impact the target implementation date.

Quality Requirements: Supplier shall confirm dimensional compliance with the revised specification and complete required validation/testing before production release. Submit inspection and validation evidence with the quotation.

Supplier Impact: Existing supplier will need to validate the revised specification and confirm production capability. Estimated supplier lead-time impact is 2 weeks.
